summary: Add harness annotations and examples that the generated surface could not infer.
reason: GET /api/v1/chat_attendees/{id}/sync answers HTTP 200 SYNC_RUNNING for an id that does not exist, so no error path is distinguishable without inventing API semantics; the search command needed a positional fixture so its live happy path was not skipped; and the feedback parent command shipped without an Examples section.
validated_outcome: Live dogfood went from 4 failures with hollow coverage to 267/267 with coverage satisfied.
